analysis: Successful trial: host validation macro HR@10 increased from 0.6225 to 0.6275 (+0.0050, or 0.5 percentage points). Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.700, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.640, Electronics 0.425, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.745. Electronics remains the weakest category; category-level improvements cannot be established without baseline category metrics. Results support retaining the latest-item query extension, but do not prove its mechanism or statistical reliability. No test metrics were used. Allocated GPU time was 1,471.42 seconds.
code_summary: One independently trained LightGCN per category, with three propagation layers and 64-dimensional embeddings by default. Gated history attention combines propagated item vectors with relative-position embeddings. Its query adds a learned projection of the rightmost valid history item to the propagated-user projection. The added projection starts at zero without changing the backbone initialization RNG stream. Training retains prefix supervision, supervised-edge masking, sampled cross-entropy, and embedding regularization. Diagnostics check padding, repeated items, empty histories, gradients, and serialization parity. Prediction strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category and uses identical history processing; no ensembles or separately fitted scorers are introduced.
